text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: P-Pardon the intrusion...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yee-haw!! Welcome to my room! Let's play a 
whole bunch today!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Acknowledged.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Let's see—this one. And... this should be 
a King?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Yay! A match! Fufu, following the 
Queen, the King has been rescued too.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
What's that!? How can you memorize all the 
card positions so well!? Amazing!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. Splendid... focus.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Four 9s. Four of a kind. ...Revolution.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Nooooooo!? At this rate, I'm gonna become 
the Grand Beggar!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
So that was your aim...! Guh... as 
expected of you, Kris S-san!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Playing with friends is super fun! Now 
then, what should we play next!?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah... sorry, Taiki-san. We should probably 
head out soon—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh... it's already time to go home? Time 
flies too fast when you're having fun...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Please invite us again. Next time together 
with your roommate, Dober-san— Huh? 
Speaking of which, where is Dober-san...?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
She's visiting home right now... That's 
why if you two leave, I'll be all 
lonely...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So, well... won't you hang out with me 
just a little longer?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I wanted an all-nighter with you 
two, so I prepared a whole bunch of stuff!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Not just playing cards! I got all kinds of 
board games ready, and even rented some 
Western movie DVDs!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I bought tons of snacks and juice too! 
Phew~! Talk about being prepared and so 
happy!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
There's even a big-sized cake! —Aah!? It's 
so big, it won't fit on the plate even 
after slicing it!?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Um, Kris S-san. If it's okay with 
you... I'd like to hang out with Taiki-san 
a bit longer...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. ...No problem.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
! Fufu... I'm glad you feel the same way, 
Kris S-san!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Taiki-san! In that case... would you care 
to play with us just a little longer?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh... my friend...! You'll really grant my 
selfish wish...!?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Mmmh~! Very, very thank you! I love you 
both so much!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Glomp!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Wha... Taiki-san!? The hug... i-is so... 
tight...!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...You are... emotional. Very honest... 
with your feelings.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted some horse girls 
walking through the courtyard with wobbly, 
unsteady steps.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah... yes, we're fine! We were just having 
so much fun that we lost track of time and 
stayed up late... *yawn*...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
*mumble mumble*... Yes...! We totally 
enjoyed a pajama party yesterday! It was 
such a happy time...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. A lively... night.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Let's have another room party sometime! I 
still have tons more Western 
recommendations!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, can't wait... *snooze*...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted a horse girl walking 
through the courtyard with wobbly, 
unsteady steps.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I lack sleep, but I'm totally okay! 
...*yawn*...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Last night... that party with friends was 
crazy exciting!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So... I feel like I'll have some good 
dreams during today's class... *snooze*...
